title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：tour　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the guide ① made the tour that no traveller in the valley would have counted, and he said the making was the whole of the day. The ② tour, meaning the trip itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed uncounted in the book; a tour, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ tour in that valley had the same short map beside it, and the ④ tour at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the guide said the counting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tour was the whole of the matter, meaning the sight and not the trip. The ⑥ tour, meaning the sight and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; tour, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a trip and a sight. He said the sight is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ tour had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ tour of the whole thing, the guide wrote in July, was one valley and three days of counting; tour, he said, is either the mark at the far ledge or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tour I remember is the trip counted in the guidebook, which closed in 1971 and is still counted as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ tour, my mother said in 1973, is the only trip that improves by being counted; every tour, she said, is a sight that has agreed to look like a trip. She said the sight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 旅行；巡演（指山谷里每一趟旁边的那一趟）
B. n. 旅行；巡演（指那趟旅行本身，与小小的地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the tour 做这一趟旅行
D. n. 旅行；巡演（指留给孩子们找的那一处）
E. n. 旅行之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的旅行之事）
F. n. 旅行；巡演（指旅行手册里写到、被清点的那一趟）
G. n. 旅行、见闻（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见闻（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the tour that no traveller in the valley would have counted
The tour, meaning the trip itself and not the map
the tour at the far ledge
the tour was the whole of the matter
the tour had become a line in a guidebook
The tour of the whole thing
A tour, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: make the tour 意为“做这一趟旅行”，1964 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位旅人肯清点的一趟旅行做了一遍。
tour 意为“旅行；巡演”，指那趟旅行本身而不是小小的地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被清点。
tour 意为“旅行；巡演”，指山谷里每一趟旁边的那一趟，每一趟旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
tour 意为“旅行；巡演”，指最远那处崖台的留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tour 意为“旅行、见闻”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这趟见闻就是那件事的全部。
tour 意为“见闻”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那趟旅行，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tour 意为“旅行；巡演”，指旅行手册里写到、被清点的那一趟，到 1969 年这一趟成了旅行手册里的一行。
tour 意为“旅行之事”，向导七月写道，整件事的旅行之事是一处山谷和三个日子的清点。
tour 意为“旅行；巡演”，我记得的是旅行手册里清点过的那一趟，1971 年走完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一趟。
tour 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，旅行是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的旅行。
